criteria.description: Whole connected ivory silhouette; straight bone shafts, readable elbows/knees and continuous distinct hands. Deep pickup avoids the previous elbow/knee knot.
Both visible hands wrap their actual carton edges, close before load, stay attached through lift/carry and open only after support.

Approach ends in a closer stationary stance before grip; clear elbows/knees in a purposeful crouch. Actual carton remains fixed until lift, then follows a short continuous path to close loaded carry, with flexed elbows, visible counterpose and unchanged final bench placement. Actual contours do not penetrate carton. Weight/readability require images and motion.
Hands and forearms withdraw continuously clear of drawn bench/legs; relaxed hands remain distinct from knees.
Control poses distinguish preparation, grip, lifted hold, carry, landing and release. Full temporal/artistic acceptance awaits complete motion/final playback.

During approach and carry, both feet alternately lead and swing foot visibly passes the fixed stance foot; continuous forward body travel, short coherent transfer and deliberate stop before the closer pickup stance. Closing stance at stop must not become the repeated walking pattern. No planted-foot sliding or flight. This control stage reviews the passing poses; complete rhythm/naturalness remains MOTION/FINAL normal/half-speed playback. Compare loaded near/far stance, foot landings and vertical pelvis response: no repeatedly locked far knee or one-sided pelvis drop. Foot-passing alone cannot approve rhythm or absence of limp.
